newsitem.title: UK: Hanson H1 profit progress across most units.
newsitem.headline: Hanson H1 profit progress across most units.

text.p: Hanson Plc, the building group which inherits the name of the once-mighty conglomerate which completed its demerging earlier this year, reported progress across all divisions in its first half results.

Building materials unit ARC saw operating profit up to 30.7 million stg from 28.9 million, but sales slipped back to 245 million. The outlook was seen improving as the broader building marekt improved in the UK and March price rises began to take effect.
